fields.description: Warn the worker when a product arrives with little shelf life left. Example: 30 means warn when less than 30% of the item's shelf life is left (an item that keeps 100 days, arriving with 25 days left). 0 turns the warning off. The item's Shelf Life In Days must be set in ERPNext.
fields.label: Short Shelf Life Warning (%)
Read GS1 Barcodes
fields.description: Read the GTIN, batch and expiry date from GS1-128 and GS1 DataMatrix codes (the long codes on cartons and medicines). The expiry date is filled in for the worker.
The worker must type the number on the supplier's invoice before sending a shipment for review. It is written on the Purchase Receipt and filled in the Purchase Invoice.
fields.label: Require Supplier Invoice No
Free Quantity from Supplier Offers
fields.description: For suppliers who add free goods (for example 12 delivered, 2 of them free). The worker enters how many of the received quantity are free. On approval the Purchase Receipt gets a free row at price 0 linked to a Pricing Rule for the offer, and the item's cost is spread over all the units. Off: the field is not shown.

Who can approve receipts, decide over-receipts and wrong items, and send shipments back. Empty: Hasr Supervisor. System Manager can always approve. Nobody approves a shipment they received themselves.
fields.label: Roles That Can Approve

fields.description: On the Today's Shipments page, a shipment that matches its order can be approved with one click. On: that click also submits the Purchase Receipt and stock moves at once. Off: the receipt stays a draft for someone to check and submit.
fields.label: One-Click Approval Submits the Receipt
Allow Stock Freeze
fields.description: Lets a supervisor freeze the items of a count, so nothing moves in or out of the warehouse until the count is approved.

fields.label: Maximum Freeze (Hours)
fields.description: A freeze lifts by itself after this many hours, so a forgotten count never blocks sales for long. 0 means no limit.

fields.label: Supervisor Test Count (%)
fields.description: Share of the lines within tolerance that the supervisor counts again before approving, as a spot check. Example: 10 means one line in ten. 0 turns it off.

fields.label: Class A: Top Share of Usage Value (%)
fields.description: Items that make up this share of the value used in the last 12 months are class A (counted most often). Default 80.

fields.label: Class B: Up to Share of Usage Value (%)
fields.description: The next items up to this cumulative share are class B; the rest are class C. Default 95.

fields.label: Tolerance and Count Frequency by ABC Class
Tolerance A (%)
fields.description: A count of a class A item may differ from the system by this share of its balance before it is recounted.

fields.label: Tolerance C (%)
fields.description: Also used for items without an ABC class yet.

fields.label: Count Class A Every (Days)
fields.description: Used by the ABC Due scope: an item is due when it has not been counted for this many days.
